title: On the existence of meromorphic solutions of the complex Schrödinger equation with a q-shift
summary: In this paper, we study the following complex Schrödinger equation with a $q$-difference term: \begin{align}\tag{†}\label{dagger} f'(z) = a(z)f(qz) + R(z, f(z)), \quad R(z, f(z)) = \frac{P(z, f(z))}{Q(z, f(z))}, \end{align} where $a(z) \not\equiv 0$ is a small meromorphic function with respect to $f(z)$, and all the coefficient functions of $R(z, f(z))$ are also small meromorphic functions with respect to $f(z)$.
